extracted.name: Egg and Spinach Casserole
extracted.description: This quick spinach, egg, and cottage cheese casserole is ready in just 1 hour.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10 ounce) package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1 (16 ounce) package small curd cottage cheese
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish with cooking spray.

Beat eggs, onion, and flour in a mixing bowl until flour is no longer lumpy. Stir in spinach, cottage cheese, Cheddar cheese, butter, salt, and pepper until evenly combined; pour into the prepared dish.
Bake casserole in the preheated oven until bubbly and golden brown, about 45 minutes.
